t.why: A transit route for Caspian oil and gas to Europe. It fought a war with Russia in 2008.
t.rel: It fought a war with Russia in 2008, and Russian troops remain in Abkhazia and South Ossetia. It is an EU candidate, but its accession process has stalled since 2024 amid accusations of a pro-Russian turn.
t.know: Traces of winemaking there go back 8,000 years.
t.etext: A transit corridor linking Russia and Central Asia with Europe. Wine, tourism, manganese alloys and re-exports of used cars are the main sources of income.
